title: Add on-demand AG News and Emotion dataset adapters
description:
## Scope

Provide explicit Hugging Face download commands using immutable revisions and canonical labels. Record licensing/attribution separately from MIT code licensing. Reuse known pinned revisions where replicating history; never use an implicit latest revision or download during specs.

## Definition of done

Offline fixture specs verify source split/index, label mapping, normalized-text hash, and stable IDs; live loaders download only when explicitly invoked and source text is excluded from Git artifacts.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Add on-demand AG News and Emotion dataset adapters
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a pinned dataset revision and a local fixture with canonical labels
    When the preparation adapter maps its rows
    Then source identifiers, normalized hashes, and label mapping are stable without network access
```
